authority: Layer-1 ladder plus Layer-2 ADAPTATION_POLICY v1; no policy changes

bootstrap.components: union of existing duplicate families and frozen prompt_sim_0.90 clusters
bootstrap.interval: simultaneous max-absolute standardized deviation, q95 higher

blend.grid: nonnegative multiples of 1/4 summing to one, plus exact equal weights
blend.meta_validation: leave one existing fold out, each view separately
blend.membership: smallest system with robust held-out marginal value; no deletion-neutral members

acoustic_probability_extension.reason: legacy VALIDATION_OOF_FIXED exports only hard predictions
acoustic_probability_extension.base: existing imputer/StandardScaler/SVC C10 gamma scale recipe
acoustic_probability_extension.inner_calibration: sigmoid, 3 fixed stratified group folds in VB and stratified folds in VA
acoustic_probability_extension.requirement: separately refit original uncalibrated anchor and check hard-prediction parity; calibrated outputs are explicitly a new realization

egemaps.head: existing imputer/StandardScaler/logistic C0.3 recipe
egemaps.rule: core vs small-weight addition only; no standalone membership search

stage5.features: one equal feature-union of word (1,2) and char_wb (3,5) TF-IDF, vocabulary/IDF fit in outer training only
stage5.head: L2 logistic C0.3 max_iter5000
stage5.controls: unchanged folds; singleton/non-singleton/mixed/close-neighbor strata; second diagnostic fits exclude outer-validation prompt90 clusters from training

stage6.candidate: one single linear scalar temporal attention scorer plus weighted mean/std and linear four-class head
stage6.scope: one prospective encoder chosen once under policy 5.3
stage6.initialization: uniform attention and matching logistic head
stage6.training: CPU FP32; ordinary CE plus L2 classifier penalty; Adam LR0.001; attention L2 coefficient0.01; maximum30 epochs, patience5, cyclic training-only existing-fold stopping, epoch0 included
stage6.rule: stable held-out standalone and system value required; no sweep

notes: Engineering defaults for the single authorized text/pooling implementation are registered before their OOF is produced. They are not additions to or relaxations of scientific gates. An absent supported layer-mixture control or absent ex-ante API-unavailability record remains UNKNOWN and fails G2.
